ground_truth.title: Patagonia Men's Nano Puff Jacket
ground_truth.main_content:
PATAGONIA

Men's Nano Puff Jacket

$229.00 Excl. tax

In stock (1)

Engineered as a weather-resistant, lightweight, and packable synthetic insulation layer for climbers, the warm-even-when-wet Nano Puff series from Patagonia has become a favorite for daily, year-round use both around town or at the crag.

Product description

Specs:

- Weight: 13 oz (369 g)
- 100% recycled polyester ripstop shell with DWR (durable water repellent) finish
- PrimaLoft® Gold Insulation Eco 100% postconsumer recycled polyester with P.U.R.E (Produced Using Reduced Emissions) technology for excellent warmth-to-weight ratio
- Improved shoulder and elbow fit for greater range of motion
- Two zippered handwarmer pockets and interior zippered chest pocket; packs down into interior chest pocket
- Made in a Fair Trade Certified™ factory
